probes.name: Complete removal of Puppeteer and Chromium from package.json
probes.details: Zero occurrences of puppeteer, puppeteer-core, or @sparticuz/chromium in dependencies or devDependencies.

probes.name: Elimination of browser process spawning and unsafe flags in DraftExportService
probes.details: Verified no browser imports, no child process execution, and no --no-sandbox CLI flags exist in DraftExportService.

probes.name: Elimination of Chromium HTML / DOM rendering attack surface (file:// and SSRF)
probes.details: HTML rendering engine and DOM evaluation completely superseded by in-process AST-to-PDF compiler.

probes.name: Font descriptors use standard PostScript PDF built-in fonts without filesystem paths
probes.details: Verified fonts configuration references only built-in standard PDF font families (Helvetica, Times-Roman, Courier). No filesystem paths (.ttf, .otf, slashes) present.

probes.name: Prohibition of user-controlled font overrides in AST parser
probes.details: AST compiler maps only fixed system fonts (Courier for code/codeBlock, Helvetica as defaultStyle). User input cannot inject arbitrary font descriptors.

probes.name: Linear performance and memory stability on large AST structures (1,000 blocks)
probes.details: Compiled 1,000 paragraphs into valid PDF in 374ms (size: 70786 bytes).

probes.name: Stack safety under deeply nested AST hierarchy (100 levels)
probes.details: Successfully handled 100 levels of recursive nesting without stack overflow (PDF size: 2620 bytes).

probes.name: Graceful degradation and null-safety on malformed, unknown, or primitive ASTs
probes.details: All malformed inputs safely handled and compiled into valid fallback PDFs without process termination.

probes.name: Defensive type check for non-array content properties
probes.details: Non-array content properties gracefully ignored or handled.

probes.name: Zero server-side execution of link URIs during compilation
probes.details: Verified that link URIs are treated purely as passive data attributes in PDF dictionaries; no server-side fetching, execution, or local file access occurs during compilation.

probes.name: Absence of complex or vulnerable regular expressions in DraftExportService
